documents.unit: Artificial Intelligence Policy Committee (A-State Knowledge Base)
documents.title: Guidelines and Considerations for the Ethical Use of Artificial Intelligence
documents.summary: University-wide guidelines from a faculty-administrator committee that leave AI rules to colleges, departments and instructors. They describe four syllabus approaches, give common definitions, and set out how detection tools (Turnitin, K-16) may be used alongside human review and a student right to respond.
documents.stance_why: The document sets no university rule: it says "faculty retain the authority to determine the scope of acceptable usage of AI in their courses" and offers four approaches (Use Prohibited, Use with Permission, Use with Acknowledgement, Use Freely Permitted) for instructors to pick, so stance is delegates with tiers listed.
